meta.name: camsnap
meta.description: Capture frames or clips from RTSP/ONVIF cameras.

copy.tagline: 从网络摄像头抓取画面或视频片段
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从RTSP/ONVIF摄像头获取视频帧或片段
copy.tagline_en: Capture frames or clips from network cameras
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to grab frames or clips from RTSP/ONVIF cameras

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你从网络摄像头抓拍照片、录制短视频，或监控画面变化。
howto.when: 当你需要查看摄像头画面、保存一段录像，或设置运动检测时触发。

say.text: 帮我从厨房摄像头拍一张照片。
say.note: 会执行 snap 命令并返回图片。

say.text: 录制客厅摄像头最近5秒的视频。
say.note: 会执行 clip 命令生成视频文件。

say.text: 监控后门摄像头，检测到运动就通知我。
say.note: 会启动 watch 命令持续监测。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can capture snapshots, record short clips, or monitor motion events from your RTSP/ONVIF cameras.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to view a camera feed, save a recording, or set up motion detection.

say_en.text: Take a snapshot from the kitchen camera.
say_en.note: Executes snap command and returns image.

say_en.text: Record a 5-second clip from the living room camera.
say_en.note: Executes clip command to generate video.

say_en.text: Watch the back door camera and alert me on motion.
say_en.note: Starts watch command for continuous monitoring.
